node.label: Reduced tissue tripeptidyl peptidase 1 activity
node.definition: Activity of tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1;EC 3.4.14.9) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. TTP1 activity can be measured in tissues including fibroblasts and leukocytes muscle.

evidence.snippet: Ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 2: Reduced tissue tripeptidyl peptidase 1 activity (frequency 2/2) [PCS]
